page.layout: One page of text, single column, no marginal notes. Running head at top centre with page number at top left. Headings and italic questions are set in the body column. A catchword sits at the bottom right.

main_text.l: QUIS EST VICESIMUS
sextus Titulus?
De suspectis tutoribus vel curatoribus.

l.i: Cui datum est jus removendi tutores suspectos?

main_text.l: DAtum est jus removendi tutores suspectos Ro-
mæ prætori,& in provinciis præsidibus earum,
& legato proconsulis.in princ.inst.cod.
Possunt quidem omnes tutores fieri suspecti, sive
sint testamentarij, sive non sint, sed alterius generis
tutores.§.ostendimus.inst.eod.
Sciendum est,quasi publicam esse hanc accusatio-
nem,hoc est,omnibus patere. Quinimò & mulieres
admittuntur ex rescripto Divorum Severi & Anto-
nini: sed eæ solæ, quæ pietatis necessitudine ductæ,
ad hoc procedunt utputa mater, nutrix quoque & a-
via: potest & soror.§.consequens.inst.eod.
Suspectus est qui non ex fide tutelam gerit, licet
solvendo sit.§. suspectus.inst.eod.
Sciendum est eos,qui fraudulenter tutelam admi-
nistrant, etiamsi satis offerant, removendos esse à tu-
tela: quia satisdatio tutoris propositum malevolum
non mutat, sed diutius grassandi in re familiari facul-
tatem præstat.§.novissime. inst.eod.

page.notes: Black-letter German title lines were transcribed inside bl tags. The "D" of "Datum" is a drop initial, joined to its word. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. The "§" references and the catchword are printed as shown. No doubtful readings were marked. Scan is slightly faded at the top left, but all text is clear.
